boundedness_note: The driver rejects stdout larger than 128,000 bytes before parsing, after first durably preserving raw streams and transport. The SSH call itself is time-limited to 60 seconds. The response is generated by the fixed reviewed stop body with bounded cgroup traversal.
limitations: No SSH, systemd, B, tests, imports, stop execution, or payload access was performed by this reviewer.
This source review does not establish that the stop was submitted or succeeded; that requires the separately captured raw transport and exact receipt.
scope: Local static source/metadata review only. The root transport capture driver was not executed.
verified_source_properties: The root driver pins the exact D directory, reviewed remote body, remote source-review JSON, ROOT acceptance, unit, and invocation before its sole SSH submission. It refuses prior stdout/stderr/transport/EXACT_STOP outcomes and its local metadata reads are O_NOFOLLOW, exact-size/SHA checked.
The only remote command is one `ssh -T` call with BatchMode, ConnectTimeout=10, ConnectionAttempts=1, and a 60-second timeout, feeding the exact pinned body on stdin. No retry path exists.

On return or timeout, stdout and stderr are written byte-for-byte with create-only `xb`, file fsync, and parent-directory fsync. The exact transport record is likewise durably written before outcome parsing. The accepted response is not reserialized: EXACT_STOP.json is a create-only copy of the original stdout bytes.

The parser requires the exact 13-field stop receipt and exact unit/invocation/acceptance digest, pre-stop successful active/exited native tuple, zero stop status and empty stop outputs, and post-stop not-found/inactive/dead/PID-zero/empty-invocation tuple with both process inventories empty.
The driver is a capture/transport layer only. It does not name/query old failed export units, prior support or fit units, and does not read or hash model/checkpoint/prediction payloads.
